decisive_items: diffuse coalescent erythematous rash over the extremities, chest, and abdomen, with scaling and crusting of the back
heliotrope rash and erythematous lip swelling
response.rationale: R1 has classic dermatomyositis features (heliotrope rash, proximal weakness, elevated CK, anti-SAE, Wong-type biopsy) while R2 only has anti-SSA which is non-specific, R4 has CT findings but no myositis, R6 has transaminitis but no myositis.

rejected.why: Only anti-SSA, not specific for dermatomyositis.
CT findings are non-specific and RA history is not the main presentation.
Elevated transaminases and hepatitis history are not the main diagnosis.
